body_long:
One of the best-known addresses in the Swiss Alps may have a new owner. According to the local outlet Gstaad Confidential, Dona Bertarelli has sold The Park Gstaad to the Greek shipping owner George Prokopiou, founder of Dynacom Tankers Management.

The price is estimated at CHF 350 to 400 million. Neither side has commented, and the sale has not been officially confirmed. If the figure holds, it would be the most expensive single-hotel sale on record in Switzerland.

## A hotel in the middle of its rebuild

Dona Bertarelli took over the hotel in 2003. The Park closed in 2024 for a full rebuild, managed by Squircle Capital, with interiors by the French designer Joseph Dirand.

It will reopen as The Park Gstaad, A Four Seasons Hotel. Four Seasons says the opening is set for mid-2027, in time for the summer season, after plans for a winter 2026-27 reopening were pushed back.

The new hotel will have 75 rooms and suites, including penthouse residences on the sixth and seventh floors. Four Seasons also lists seven restaurants and lounges, indoor and outdoor pools, and a spa with two treatment rooms dedicated to Clinique La Prairie.

## The team in place

In May 2026, Four Seasons named Reto Moser general manager. Born and raised in Switzerland, he joined the group in Provence in 2004, then worked in food and beverage in Bangkok and Koh Samui before senior roles in Cairo, Moscow and Dubai.

A change of owner would not, on its own, change the management agreement with Four Seasons. What it would change is the price the market puts on a 75-key hotel in Gstaad.

## The signal

Alpine luxury is now priced like a trophy asset. Very few new hotels can be built in villages such as Gstaad, and buyers from outside hospitality, from shipping to finance, are ready to pay for that scarcity.

For hoteliers, the lesson is that the brand and the operator now matter as much as the walls. A Four Seasons flag, a famous designer and a protected location are what turn a historic hotel into a record deal.

We will update this story if the sale is confirmed.
summary: Dona Bertarelli is reported to have sold The Park Gstaad to George Prokopiou for an estimated CHF 350 to 400 million, ahead of its reopening as a Four Seasons hotel in mid-2027. The sale is not confirmed.
